question: **How many mathematicians won the Michael Sheila Prize for 2021?**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Three**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The first paragraph of the given passage states that,
 
 
• *"Indian mathematician **Nikhil Srivastava, working at the University of California in Berkeley, is among the winners of the Prestigious 2021 Michael and Sheila Held Prize__**, announced last week by the US National Academy of Sciences (NAS). **__Adam W Marcus, EPFL (Swiss Federal Institute of Technology, Lausanne) and Daniel Alan Spielman, Yale University, are the other two winners."__***
 
 
 
• ​From the unlined part of the above paragraph, we can say that Three mathematicians won the Michael Sheila Prize for 2021.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2.**
